parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

days.description: Day objects returned by the content payload when present.

halls.description: Hall objects included in the event content payload.

lectures.description: Lecture session objects in the event content payload.

pauses.description: Pause or break objects in the event content payload.

speakers.description: Speaker objects included in the event content payload.

tracks.description: Track objects included in the event content payload.

workshops.description: Workshop session objects in the event content payload.
